text: DeepSeek Balance Monitor 是面向 DSH 网页端的余额监控插件，在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并每 60 秒刷新。它通过 host 路由向 DeepSeek 余额接口取数，在侧边栏展示 CNY、USD 或两种币种，并按各自阈值着色；设置页可调整显示币种和告警阈值，保存后实时生效。适合需要在 DSH 页面查看 DeepSeek 账户余额的用户。使用前需设置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 并拥有 DeepSeek 账户。

DeepSeek Balance Monitor shows account balances in the DSH web sidebar, refreshed every 60 seconds. Choose CNY, USD, or both and set per-currency warning thresholds in live settings. It fetches balances through a host route. Requires a DeepSeek account and DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
想在 DSH 网页侧边栏随时查看 DeepSeek 账户余额。
能不能在余额低时给我明显的颜色提醒？
我想选择只显示 CNY 或 USD 余额。
让 DSH 每隔一段时间自动刷新 DeepSeek 余额。
I want to see my DeepSeek account balance in the DSH sidebar.
Can I set separate low-balance thresholds for CNY and USD?
DeepSeek Balance Monitor 的功能「侧边栏余额」：在 DSH 网页侧栏底部展示账户余额，页面载入时读取并每 60 秒刷新；侧栏收起时隐藏。
DeepSeek Balance Monitor 的功能「币种与阈值」：可选择显示 CNY、USD 或两者，并分别设置余额预警阈值；余额按阈值显示颜色，阈值为 0 时不告警。
DeepSeek Balance Monitor 的功能「设置管理」：在插件信息页和插件行配置页编辑显示币种及两个阈值，保存或重置后通过共享设置表单更新。
DeepSeek Balance Monitor 使用前须知：需在 host 环境配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY；host 会携带该密钥请求 api.deepseek.com 的账户余额接口。
怎么在 DSH 里快速确认 DeepSeek 账户还剩多少余额？
Show me my DeepSeek balance alongside my DSH workspace.

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · dsh-deepseek-balance：一个常驻的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Cordis 插件，用于在侧边栏底部、Settings 按钮正上方展示你的 DeepSeek 账户余额。

> [!NOTE] > **AI 生成声明**:本插件由 AI 生成，可能存在错误、安全隐患或不符合预期之处，使用前请自行 review 代码并实测；发现任何问题欢迎提交 issue 或 PR 修正。 > [!IMPORTANT] > **兼容性**：本版本面向 **dsh ≥ 0.2.1-rc.1**（0.1.x 请使用 0.5.x）。

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · 特性：- 在左侧边栏底部、Settings 上方展示当前 DeepSeek 账户余额，每 60 秒自动刷新。
- 三种显示模式：仅 CNY、仅 USD、或同时显示两者；可为 CNY/USD 分别配置预警阈值 —— 余额低于阈值显示红色、低于其两倍显示黄色（0 = 禁用预警）。
- 配置实时生效 —— 设置写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 配置行（由 dsh settings 服务读写），保存后立即生效，无需重启 `dsh web`，也不会重挂插件。
- 设置区直接出现在「设置 → 插件 → 余额监控」的插件信息页里（与 CodeBuddy 桥接插件的呈现方式一致）；`deepseek-balance` 行的配置页入口同时保留。
- 当侧边栏收起（rail 模式）时自动隐藏。
- 从 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 环境变量读取 API 密钥。

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · 架构：| 端 | 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `lib/index.js` | 导出 schemastery `Config`（三个 `volatile` 字段），dsh 的 settings 缝据此为本插件条目生成可编辑表单；注册 `/deepseek-balance`（代理 [DeepSeek Get User Balance API](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/get-user-balance)） |
| Client | `lib/client.js` | 在 `sidebar.footer.action` 槽位注册余额展示（60 秒轮询）；在 `plugins.bundle.config` 槽位以包名 `@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance` 为 key 注册插件信息页的设置区，并在 `plugins.row.config` 槽位以 `@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance#deepseek-balance` 为 key 注册该插件行的配置页，读写经 `ctx.configForms` |

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · 架构：```
Browser (Client half)  --fetch /deepseek-balance-->  Host HTTP route  -->  api.deepseek.com/user/balance
Browser (Client half)  --ctx.configForms-->  remote.settings  -->  profile 的 cordis.patch.yml（本插件配置行）
```

dsh 0.2 起，设置不再由插件自建命名空间：Loader 条目导出的 `Config` schema 会被 settings 服务（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`）投影成表单，写入落到 profile 的 patch 文档；浏览器侧通过 `ctx.configForms` 拿到同一份快照并提交 `mutate` 操作，因此侧边栏读数与配置页共享同一份数据，保存后即时同步，不再需要插件自建的 HTTP 设置代理。

text: @choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · dsh-deepseek-balance：A persistent [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Cordis plugin that shows your DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer, right above the Settings button.

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · dsh-deepseek-balance：> [!NOTE] 
> **AI-generated disclaimer**: This plugin was generated by AI. It may contain errors, security issues, or behave unexpectedly. Please review the code and test it yourself before use; feel free to submit an issue or PR if you find any problems.

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · dsh-deepseek-balance：> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility**: this release targets **dsh ≥ 0.2.1-rc.1** (0.1.x stays on 0.5.x). The host derives the settings form from the entry's exported `Config` schema through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`, and the browser reaches the same seam through `ctx.configForms` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings`).

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · Features：- Displays your current DeepSeek account balance at the bottom of the left sidebar, above Settings, auto-refreshing every 60 seconds.
- Three display modes: CNY only, USD only, or both; per-currency warning thresholds color the readout red below the threshold and yellow below twice it (0 disables the warning).
- Live config — the values live in the plugin's own row in the profile `cordis.patch.yml`, read and written by the dsh settings service; saves apply immediately, without restarting `dsh web` and without remounting the plugin.
- The settings section is rendered directly on the plugin's own page (Settings → Plugins → **Balance Monitor**), the same way the CodeBuddy bridge plugin does it; the `deepseek-balance` row keeps its configure page.
- Hides automatically when the sidebar is collapsed (rail mode).
- Reads the API key from the `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` environment variable.

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · Architecture：| Half | File | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `lib/index.js` | Exports the schemastery `Config` (three `volatile` fields) the settings seam projects into an editable form for this entry, plus `/deepseek-balance` (proxies the [DeepSeek Get User Balance API](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/get-user-balance)) |
| Client | `lib/client.js` | Registers the balance readout in the `sidebar.footer.action` slot (60 s poll), the settings section on the bundle page in `plugins.bundle.config` keyed by the package name, and the row's configuration page in `plugins.row.config` keyed `@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance#deepseek-balance`; reads and writes settings through `ctx.configForms` |

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · Architecture：```
Browser (Client half)  --fetch /deepseek-balance-->  Host HTTP route  -->  api.deepseek.com/user/balance
Browser (Client half)  --ctx.configForms-->  remote.settings  -->  the plugin's row in the profile cordis.patch.yml
```

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · Architecture：Since dsh 0.2 a plugin no longer registers a settings namespace of its own: the `Config` schema a Loader entry exports is projected into a form by the settings service, and writes land in the profile patch document. The browser half reads the same document through `ctx.configForms` and submits `mutate` operations, so the sidebar readout and the configuration page share one source of truth — a save reaches both with no plugin-owned HTTP settings proxy and no poll.

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · Via [plugin-registry](https://github.com/vlln/plugin-registry)：Settings → Plugins → Install, and set the source to `@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance` or `github:Choi-Peng/dsh-deepseek-balance`.

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · Manual Installation：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:Choi-Peng/dsh-deepseek-balance"
```

The package ships its own `cordis.patch.yml` (`dsh.bundle.patch` in `package.json`), which dsh applies automatically when installing the plugin — **no need to hand-edit the profile-level `cordis.patch.yml`**. Restart `dsh web` for it to take effect (plugin discovery is cached per process).

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · Uninstalling：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove @choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance
```

The bundle mount disappears with the plugin; if you ever wrote the row into the profile-level patch manually, remove it first.

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · Configuration：| Layer | Source | How it applies |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Defaults | declared in the `Config` schema (`cny`, both thresholds 0) | — |
| Base (bundle) | the row `config` in the plugin bundle's own `cordis.patch.yml` (`dsh.bundle.patch`, applied automatically on install) | applies with the bundle |
| User (runtime settings) | Save/Reset from Settings → Plugins → **Balance Monitor**, written by the settings service into this plugin's row in the profile `cordis.patch.yml`; Reset clears the overrides and falls back to the bundle defaults | applies immediately |

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · Configuration：The page exposes
`displayCurrency` (CNY only / USD only / both) and both warning
thresholds (number inputs), with Save / Reset-to-defaults. Writes carry the
read revision for optimistic concurrency — if the settings changed elsewhere,
the page reloads the latest values and tells you. The sidebar readout re-polls
the balance every 60 s. Warning rule: balance ≤ threshold turns red, ≤ twice the threshold
turns yellow, and a threshold of 0 disables the warning.

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · Configuration：The API key is read from the `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` environment variable; it is held only by the host half and sent as a `Bearer` token, never exposed to the browser.

The balance API returns all of the account's currency balances (usually CNY and USD); the sidebar shows the currencies selected by `displayCurrency`.

@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance README · Usage：1. Start `dsh web` with `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` set in the environment — the sidebar footer shows a balance readout above Settings, refreshed every 60 s.
2. Settings → Plugins → open the **Balance Monitor** (`@choi-p/dsh-deepseek-balance`) package page: the plugin info carries a *Balance Monitor* settings section — pick the displayed currency, set the warning thresholds, and Save. The `deepseek-balance` row → **Configure** opens the same form. Changes apply live without restarting `dsh web`.
